content: Grief softens the hardened heart, but courage binds the broken bones.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
explanation: You must let grief do its sacred work: weeping melts the rigid, prideful armor that blocks love. But once the tears have watered the soil, courage must step in to splint the bone, lace up the boots, and carry the household forward. Grieve deeply, then rise bravely.
practicalInsight: Honor your sadness when it arrives, but do not let it become permanent paralysis. Let courage bind your steps.
reflectionPrompt: Have you allowed a past sorrow to become a permanent identity rather than a season of healing?
